sources.title: Shilo Sanders tells Mary Kay Cabot to "go make a sandwich" after she says Deshaun Watson should be QB1
sources.description: As Shedeur Sanders and Deshaun Watson compete to be the starting quarterback of the Cleveland Browns, Shedeur's brother took issue with news about the battle from the team's recent voluntary minicamp.
